incident_description: Russian strike on a crowded market in central Chornomorsk killed four people: one at the scene and three who later died in hospital. The initial casualty report recorded one death; subsequent hospital deaths raised the final toll to four.

sources.publisher: Interfax-Ukraine, citing Odesa Regional Military Administration head Oleh Kiper
sources.notes: Initial report at 13:34 recorded one death and 11 injured.

sources.publisher: Ukrainska Pravda, citing Oleh Kiper and DSNS
sources.notes: Reports the final toll of four after two people died in hospital by 14:06 and a fourth death was later confirmed.
Reports the rise to four deaths and explains the two earlier hospital deaths and a later third hospital death.
Case file records four killed, one at the scene and three in hospital.

revision_history.reason: Initial regional administration update reported one person killed at the scene.
Two people hospitalized with severe injuries died in hospital, raising the toll to three.
A further hospitalized victim died, and Kiper confirmed the final toll of four.

incident_description: Russian drone strike in Saltivsky district killed two people and set a car on fire. The mayor first reported one death, then updated the toll to two.

sources.notes: Mayor's updates: initial report of one death, later revised to two.
Reports the mayor's final toll of two after an earlier one-death update.
Reports two people killed in the Saltivsky district strike.

revision_history.reason: Initial mayoral report said one person had been killed.
The mayor later reported two fatalities. The incident's final count is two; the project subtotal had already included the first death before this update.

incident_description: Russian attack drones struck Yahotyn, killing one person and damaging two kindergartens, homes, a vehicle and a non-residential building. A later repeat strike during firefighting killed two rescuers and is recorded separately.

sources.publisher: Kyiv Regional Military Administration head Tymur Tkachenko
sources.notes: Official report of one person killed in the initial Yahotyn attack.
Reports one person killed in the initial attack on Yahotyn.

revision_history.reason: Initial incident record created from the cited official report and corroborating coverage.

incident_description: A repeat Russian drone strike during firefighting in Yahotyn killed two State Emergency Service rescuers, Oleksandr Bondarenko and Yurii Lytovchenko. Two other rescuers were injured. This is a separate incident from the initial attack that killed one civilian.

sources.publisher: State Emergency Service of Ukraine, Kyiv region
sources.notes: Official report says two rescuers were killed during the repeat strike while extinguishing the fire.
Reports two rescuers killed by the repeat strike during firefighting.
Identifies the two rescuers and confirms they were killed in the second wave of strikes.
